column1: # Safety audit of a Claude-only draft: a QA record, not the council's back-translation.

column3: ‘Topsnelheid’ names the wrong thing: the setting on this screen is labelled ‘Maximumsnelheid’, and in the Dutch terms Topsnelheid is the measured top speed of a trip or ride, so the caution points the rider at a setting that does not exist under that name. The style guide (nl.md, Three speeds) forbids the swap and holds this key in English until D3 merges.
